subject.title: Channel setup vocabulary leaks into core (ChannelSetupInput, channels add flags, promotion keys)

question: Should the remaining promotion-key and `ChannelSetupInput` ownership work proceed as the two planned compatibility-reviewed refactor phases?
rationale: The first phase is merged, but the remaining work changes core/plugin and potentially documented SDK boundaries; maintainers should confirm sequencing and compatibility expectations before implementation.

options.title: Continue the phased migration
options.body: Sponsor focused follow-up PRs for promotion-key ownership first and the documented setup-input boundary second, with compatibility tests at each seam.

options.title: Stop after the first phase
options.body: Retain the remaining core vocabulary as an accepted compatibility cost and close the umbrella refactor without further migration.

recommendation.title: Continue the phased migration
recommendation.body: Sponsor focused follow-up PRs for promotion-key ownership first and the documented setup-input boundary second, with compatibility tests at each seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The phased plan and merged first implementation make steipete the clearest available owner for confirming the intended follow-up boundary.
